expected_duplicate_claims.symptom: UIT screen is blank and not lit up
expected_duplicate_claims.failure_mode: No AC power at the PoE power supply
expected_duplicate_claims.corrective_action: Restore AC power and replace failed fuses F3 and F4

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Machine stops in middle of cut and displays Machine Paused
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
minimum_expected_manual_chains.corrective_action: adjust the pause plunger activation pressure

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Touch Screen buttons are out of alignment
minimum_expected_manual_chains.corrective_action: complete touch screen calibration and save and exit

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: tool or layer is not mapped properly
minimum_expected_manual_chains.corrective_action: map the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
Laser cutting path is too wide
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: brass laser nozzle is damaged or bent

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: focusing lens is damaged or dirty
minimum_expected_manual_chains.corrective_action: clean or replace the focusing lens

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: beam deflecting mirror is damaged or dirty

minimum_expected_manual_chains.symptom: Loss of laser cutting power causing non-cut edges
minimum_expected_manual_chains.failure_mode: laser nozzle contains damage or debris
minimum_expected_manual_chains.corrective_action: clean or replace the laser nozzle

forbidden_cross_pairings.symptom: Touch Screen buttons are out of alignment
Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
Laser cutting path is too wide
